title: SqlServerContainerFixture InitializeAsync fails with Docker port 1433 already in use on shared CI runner
job_name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Hosting.Azure.Tests, Hosting.Azure, Hosting.Azure, tests/Aspire... / Hosting.Azure (ubuntu-latest)
error_pattern: Docker.DotNet.DockerApiException : Docker API responded with status code=InternalServerError, response={"message":"failed to set up container networking: driver failed programming external connectivity on endpoint busy_bardeen ...: failed to bind host port for 0.0.0.0::172.17.0.3:1433/tcp: address already in use"}
analysis: All 7 test failures share the identical root cause: the shared SqlServerContainerFixture attempts to start a Docker container bound to host port 1433, which is already in use on the CI runner (likely from a concurrent test run or leftover container). This is an environmental/infrastructure port-allocation conflict, not caused by the PR's Azure Container Apps Express code changes, which do not touch SQL Server test fixtures.
